purpose_context: Spec Kitty's governance vocabulary currently splits 'doctrine' (the artefact layer) from 'charter' (project materialization and activation language). The operator has decided that 'doctrine' is retired from user-facing language. The replacement distinguishes Charter Pack (a distributable catalogue), Charter Bundle (the project-local file set), Active Charter (an activated governance artefact), and Inactive Charter (an available but unactivated artefact). This mission produces the ADR, a complete content-and-path occurrence inventory, ordering/methodology analysis, and a stacked Spec Kitty mission plan. It does not execute product renames.
purpose_tldr: Plan and sequence the retirement of 'doctrine' as a user-facing term in Spec Kitty, replaced by 'charter': ADR, full occurrence inventory, ordering/methodology analysis, and a stacked mission plan.
